video_title: PlaqueBoyMax on Squashing His Drake Beef, the Iceman Rollout & Grammy Nomination

quotes.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
quotes.summary_phrase: Drake's innovative streaming rollout and A-list artists adopting streaming

text_blocks.speaker: Host 1
text_blocks.text: What do you make of these A-list artists being like, I got to step into the streaming world. I got to tap in with these people because that's where they're at.

text_blocks.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
text_blocks.text: It's inevitable. I think that it's just going to keep happening and people are going to get better and better at it. Drake's rollout recently was the best use I've seen of any artist doing. It's so crazy because typically I feel like you would see a smaller artist do it first, but for Drake to be on top of it before everybody is kind of like, damn, he knows what he's doing or he's aware at least of what's going on. I don't know if that's his team or him, but involving the streamers and involving the kids and making them part of the rollout is like, I haven't seen something like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Host 2
text_blocks.text: Why would I spend the bread and go into one of these big firms? I'd rather go to the people who got million, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 billions of followers. I can talk directly to them.

quotes.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
quotes.summary_phrase: PlaqueBoyMax on squashing his misunderstanding with Drake

text_blocks.speaker: Host 2
text_blocks.text: What happened there? How did y'all come to see eye to eye?

text_blocks.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
text_blocks.text: Drake was doing a stream with Aiden Ross. They were doing a stream and during that stream, he was saying he was watching one of my streams I was doing in a booth with D Savage. He was saying how he messed with it. He was saying good things, but the way he said it, I thought he was on some condescending, just little streamer, like, oh, he did. There are many people because this is new that will try to downplay streaming or downplay what we're doing. So I saw that. Drake is literally one of my favorite artists ever, but I just said on stream, I'm like, damn, why he say like, why was he trying to do that? The thing with streaming is it's like, if you are an authentic person, it's hard to not say some stuff that's just on your mind. That's how I am. So I was just saying that and I didn't mean it in no way that like, 'F you Drake.' I was just like, why he say it like that? And so you know the comments, 'You should be glad Drake even saw your stream.' But I'm just like, I just said that and then Drake ended up DMing me and was like, 'I didn't mean it that way,' which is crazy because he didn't have to do that. Shout out to Drake, but everything was good. I never had no problems with him. He was always good. Hopefully we do some stuff one day for sure.

quotes.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
quotes.summary_phrase: Grammy nomination changes how people perceive streaming music

text_blocks.speaker: Host 1
text_blocks.text: You're Grammy nominated now for Victory Lap with Fred again. Did that change how people discuss your music once you got that nomination?

text_blocks.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
text_blocks.text: For sure, because not to downplay your just take a person, just a random person that's walking in New York City. You take them, you say, 'Hey, there's this new kid on streaming platforms that's bringing people on doing all this process, having music made live.' They're going to be like, 'Okay,' they might not understand it. But you say, 'Hey, he got nominated for a Grammy!' Everyone knows what a Grammy is. So I say it definitely opened doors to how people look at stuff. Unfortunately, I didn't take that stuff home, but we'll be back.

text_blocks.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
text_blocks.text: It's still an honor for sure.

text_blocks.speaker: Host 1
text_blocks.text: It has to be. Every bio that you'll write for the rest of your life, if somebody writes about you, it'll say Grammy nominated.

quotes.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
quotes.summary_phrase: Streaming as a 'toolbox' for music success, not just a launchpad

text_blocks.speaker: Host 1
text_blocks.text: Does a nomination like that make streaming feel like it's the launchpad instead of the destination? Is the Grammy or the music success the ultimate goal or is it still making the streaming as big as it possibly can be?

text_blocks.speaker: PlaqueBoyMax
text_blocks.text: I say it's really a mix. It's hard for me to say because since everything is so new and I feel like I'm creating a path that no one has. It's hard for me to say exactly what it will end up being. I know it'll be huge, but I just don't know exactly what it looks like. I have to take it step by step. Streaming I always hold on to streaming because streaming is just like, that's what makes all this special. I think it's the early days of it, so we don't exactly know where it could grow, but I know it's going to continue to grow and just continue to get larger as people innovate and expand and try new things. I wouldn't necessarily say it's the launchpad. I say it's more like a toolbox, if anything, in terms of making all these things possible because you could take streaming and make a bunch of things possible. It's what it can do for you.
